text: The purpose of this report is to advise the Parks and Environment Committee on the outcome of funding applications made by City Divisions to Ontario's Municipal GHG (greenhouse gas) Challenge Fund. Ontario's Ministry of Environment and Climate Change (MOECC) has awarded the City of Toronto with $52 million for 10 major GHG emission reduction projects. These innovative, next-generation projects will expand high-performance buildings, build low‑carbon thermal energy networks, deploy electric vehicles, and utilize biogas as energy from waste. The projects receiving funding are well aligned with the short-term actions identified in the TransformTO Climate Action Strategy.
